note: Sickness from rotten food (Dave 2026-10-21): you are sick for about 1 game day (24 game hours, one real hour). Vomiting and diarrhoea: exertion cannot fall below exertion_floor (0.5) while it lasts, and every symptom_every_s real seconds one symptom costs some food and water. It fades faster asleep (sleep_mult times as fast) and by medicine (vitals.json medicines, cure_h game hours each). Shown as Sick on the inventory and Tab screens, never on the main screen. This is separate from water: clean and dirty water do not exist (Dave).

symptoms.say: Your stomach cramps and you run for the bushes

say_start: It was rotten. You feel sick.
